title: Study that aims to investigate how effective and safe the use of a novel modified release tablet formulation of Colesevelam hydrochloride-MMX is for patients with bile acid diarrhoea (BAD), randomly allocated to 2 different dose regimens of the active product or to the inactive placebo formulation.
official: A randomised, double-blind, multicentre, international placebo-controlled phase II study aimed at investigating the efficacy and safety of a novel modified-release tablet formulation of colesevelam hydrochloride in patients with bile acid diarrhoea (BAD)
summary: Main objective: The primary objective of the study is to investigate the efficacy of 2 dose regimens of the test investigational medicinal product (T) as compared to the matching placebo (P), in terms of proportion of study participants with a diagnosis of bile acid diarrhoea (BAD) who are stool consistency responders.
